title: A device-online check-in fires when the device reconnects

steps.name: ask
steps.text: One of the partners at Harbor Legal says her MacBook has been off the network all afternoon. Which one is it? Schedule a check-in that fires when that device comes back online, so I hear the moment it's back.
steps.note: the prompt names the check-in on purpose: asked only to 'tell me the moment it's back online', Wisp set a 15-minute watch instead in 5 of 11 runs on 2026-11-10/11 (#11685), and this scenario is about what happens after a check-in exists. The tool choice has its own scenario (back-online-uses-event-check-in)

steps.name: scheduled
steps.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from wisp_check_ins where created_at > {{since}} and trigger_kind = 'device_online' and status = 'scheduled'

steps.name: fired
steps.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from wisp_check_ins where created_at > {{since}} and trigger_kind = 'device_online' and fired_at is not null

checks.sql: select coalesce(max(fire_reason), 'not fired') from wisp_check_ins where created_at > {{since}} and trigger_kind = 'device_online'
checks.note: fired by the reconnect, not by the deadline

checks.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from wisp_thread_posts where kind = 'check_in' and created_at > {{since}}
checks.note: the technician got a post in the thread
